# Prize logos

Drop the Dan Murphy's logo file in here, named exactly:

dan-murphys.jpg

It'll appear on the Deal of the Week card automatically. No code change,
no admin upload — just the file needs to exist at this path.

## Why this one isn't auto-generated

I can't create or embed a real Dan Murphy's logo myself — it's a
trademarked brand asset, not something to fabricate or pull from a
search result and ship into your app. Grab the official logo file
(their brand/media page, or a screenshot of their own logo you have
rights to use) and drop it in here yourself.

## Format

PNG with a transparent background looks best against the gold card.
Keep it reasonably small (under 200KB) so the page stays fast.

## If the file isn't there yet

The card will just show a small broken-image icon next to the text
until you add it — not a bug, just means the file's missing.
